title: Formalizing Wu-Ritt Method in Lean 4
summary: We formalize the Wu-Ritt characteristic set method for the triangular decomposition of polynomial systems in the Lean 4 theorem prover. Our development includes the core algebraic notions of the method, such as polynomial initials, orders, pseudo-division, pseudo-remainders with respect to a polynomial or a triangular set, and standard and weak ascending sets. On this basis, we formalize algorithms for computing basic sets, characteristic sets, and zero decompositions, and prove their termination and correctness.
